_comment: Extends _ft63_pdfix_v3.json (PD-safe DD fold + D5 v3 corroboration + Jul-28
armed set + Aug-1 prefit observability tier + W6 self-contained satellite OSB).
THE ONLY DELTA vs _ft63_prires_on.json is network.prior_residual_census.
Nothing else differs, which is what makes gate 1 a valid SAME-BUILD A/B
(standing invariant #6): every solve and QC artifact must be byte-identical
between this arm and the ON arm, and only the census columns, the PRIORRES
events, network_prior_residual.csv, the manifest and the wall-clock fields may
differ.  A diff anywhere else is a STOP -- the card claims the solve is
untouched, and that claim is the acceptance criterion, not a limitation.
Note the census is deliberately ABSENT from this arm's epoch-status schema, not
merely blank: the columns are appended only when the card is armed (the
measurement-admission precedent), so an unarmed run's network_epoch_status.csv
is byte-identical to a pre-card build's.  Diff the two files with that in mind.
